rationale: The candidate reads as a compact, faceted prism with one continuous dominant mass, so it is not fragmented and it holds together in all views. However, it remains too generic and sealed for the neighborhood_living brief: the parcel is effectively filled by a compact object without a convincing public void, entry seam, or terrace on the verified access side. The silhouette is coherent but mostly arbitrary faceting rather than a program-driven section. In particular, there is no clear active ground threshold or usable court/undercut, so the mass behaves more like an object than a street-building. The references suggest that a prism-like language can work, but only when paired with stronger base/public-edge articulation or a meaningful section move. The visible form therefore fails program_fit_hard_pass despite decent repair integrity.
